acceptance: 1) Entry: public FloatingActions contact control (floating-human-contact) -> /[locale]/contact; footer Privacy policy -> /[locale]/privacy. Data source: existing InquiryWizard and local Privacy messages; no analytics API is needed. Visit both after declining analytics and observe zero Tawk requests/analytics IDs. Cookie settings distinguish necessary human contact from optional analytics (E-40). 2) With the separate chat switch off, existing inquiry submission/email links remain clickable. Do not buy capacity automatically or call the old 2.7GB snapshot current capacity. Privacy copy explains seven-day/30-day cookies and the 90-day design default while actual cleanup remains disabled; existing inquiry retention stays unchanged (E-20). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px.

E-20.trigger: Resource measurements before release are insufficient.
E-20.expect: Keep a separate switch that can disable chat while preserving the existing contact entry point. Record capacity evidence and limits; do not claim that a snapshot of about 2.7 GB of free memory equals currently available capacity, and do not automatically buy additional capacity.

E-40.scene: C-02 Offline messages and recovery from send failures
E-40.trigger: A visitor declines analytics but actively opens first-party human chat.
E-40.expect: Allow the necessary consultation without creating an analytics identifier or loading a third-party chat script. Handle the necessary chat session separately from analytics consent.
